# Evaluation plan

No performance claims are published until there is a reproducible, labelled benchmark. The first benchmark should use synthetic job descriptions and hand-reviewed expected outputs.

## Extraction metrics

- Field-level precision and recall for role title, location, work mode, and requirements.
- Requirement importance classification accuracy, reported per class.
- Provenance coverage: proportion of consequential extracted claims linked to evidence.
- Unknown handling: rate of unsupported guesses on deliberately underspecified examples.

## Scoring metrics

- Agreement with human prioritisation, with disagreement review rather than treating one annotator as objective truth.
- Score stability when non-consequential text changes.
- Sensitivity to missing dimensions and changes in stated constraints.
- Coverage reported alongside score to expose incomplete evidence.

## Evaluation hygiene

Separate development and held-out examples. Freeze the evaluation set before tuning prompts or rules. Document annotation instructions and adjudicate ambiguous cases. Report sample sizes and uncertainty; do not claim generalisation from a tiny synthetic set.
